nodes.summary: Auto-generated NetBeans Ant build script for the PrimeFactors J2SE project. Contains 1771 lines of Ant targets organized into sections: initialization, compilation, JAR building, execution, debugging, profiling, javadoc generation, test compilation/execution/debugging, applet support, and cleanup. Defines macros for javac, junit, testng, and debugging with support for both modular (Java 9+) and pre-module Java versions.

NetBeans-generated CRC checksum tracking file. Stores CRC32 checksums for build.xml and nbproject/build-impl.xml used by the IDE to detect when generated build files need regeneration. Auto-maintained by NetBeans and not intended for manual editing.

NetBeans project build configuration properties for PrimeFactors. Defines source and target Java version 11, main class (Factorzations.GUI), source/test directories (src/test), build/dist directory paths, JAR filename (PrimeFactors.jar), encoding (UTF-8), JUnit 4 test dependency, JNLP deployment settings, annotation processing configuration, javac/external VM settings, and various manifest customization options.

NetBeans project metadata descriptor. Declares the project type as org.netbeans.modules.java.j2seproject (a standard Java SE project), sets the project name to 'PrimeFactors', and defines source-roots (src.dir) and test-roots (test.src.dir) for compilation.
